result.summary: Wrote r2/lit.md answering the 4 literature questions from r2/analysis.md §5 (targeting core A = intraday volume time-centroid, core B = realized kurtosis, F1/F2 = nonlinear size fold / nominal price, N2 = screening/trimming treatments). Used WebSearch/WebFetch (loaded via ToolSearch) plus direct PDF reads and Crossref-API date checks; only used sources confirmed pre-2023-08-08, dropped one near-miss (realized-skewness-China FRL paper, Crossref created 2023-08-25) as too late. 16 academic sources (all verified:true by direct WebFetch/PDF read or multiply-corroborated WebSearch) plus 1 clearly-flagged non-academic SSE exchange-rule note; each cites title/authors/year-month/venue/link/verified. Notably found that MSCI's Barra USE4/CNE5 risk-model methodology documents (read directly from PDF) describe an industry-standard "Non-Linear Size" factor construction (cube standardized size, orthogonalize to linear Size, winsorize+standardize) that is a strong literature precedent for F1's folding mechanism; also flagged an honest sign conflict between core B's direction and the realized-kurtosis literature (Amaya et al. 2015 reports kurtosis positively, not negatively, predicts returns).
